title: Reactors in all the craft are identical

tellings.quote: Apparently the reactors in all the craft are exactly the same.

plain: The power reactors in all the alien craft were exactly the same, according to Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on recovered flying saucers in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert. Lazar tells Michels this was something he was told there rather than saw for himself ("Apparently the reactors in all the craft are exactly the same"), which would suggest the craft share one standard design.
